sections.name: Premium FAQ section
sections.purpose: Premium FAQ section — Frequently asked questions or accordion content

settings.label: Subheading
settings.default: Everything you need to know about your device

settings.label: Question
settings.default: Who is the device suitable for?

settings.label: Answer
settings.default: The device is designed for all skin types and concerns. It is particularly effective for those seeking to improve skin texture, reduce fine lines, and enhance overall skin clarity. Consult with a dermatologist if you have specific skin conditions.

settings.label: Question
settings.default: How often should I use the device?

settings.label: Answer
settings.default: For optimal results, use the device 3-4 times per week. Begin with 2-3 sessions per week during the first two weeks to allow your skin to adjust. Consistency is key to achieving visible improvements.

settings.label: Question
settings.default: Is it safe for sensitive skin?

settings.label: Answer
settings.default: Yes, the device has been dermatologically tested and is safe for sensitive skin. Start with the lowest intensity setting and gradually increase as your skin builds tolerance. Discontinue use if irritation occurs.

settings.label: Question
settings.default: When can I expect to see results?

settings.label: Answer
settings.default: Most users notice improvements in skin texture and radiance within 2-4 weeks of consistent use. Visible reduction in fine lines and enhanced firmness typically appear after 6-8 weeks. Individual results may vary.

settings.label: Question
settings.default: Can it be used with other skincare products?

settings.label: Answer
settings.default: Yes, the device works effectively with your existing skincare routine. Apply serums or moisturizers after treatment for enhanced absorption. Avoid using with retinol or exfoliating acids immediately before or after treatment.

settings.label: Question
settings.default: How do I clean and store the device?

settings.label: Answer
settings.default: Clean the device head with a soft, damp cloth after each use. Do not submerge in water. Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Ensure the device is completely dry before storing.

sections.name: FAQ Waves
sections.purpose: FAQ Waves — Frequently asked questions or accordion content

settings.label: Question
settings.default: How does the Facecube Face Massager work?

settings.label: Answer
settings.default: Our Facecube Face Massager uses advanced vibration technology and ergonomic design to provide deep facial massage. The cube-shaped design allows you to target different areas of your face, helping to improve circulation, reduce tension, and promote relaxation.

settings.question: How often should I use the Facecube Face Massager?
settings.answer: For best results, we recommend using the Facecube Face Massager 2-3 times per week, or as needed. Each session should last 5-10 minutes. Consistent use helps maintain skin elasticity and reduces facial tension over time.

settings.question: Is the Facecube Face Massager suitable for sensitive skin?
settings.answer: Yes! The Facecube Face Massager features adjustable intensity levels and is made with hypoallergenic materials. Start with the lowest setting and gradually increase as your skin becomes accustomed. Always use with a clean face and consider applying a light moisturizer or serum before use.

settings.question: Can I use the Facecube Face Massager with skincare products?
settings.answer: Absolutely! The Facecube Face Massager works excellently with serums, moisturizers, and facial oils. Apply your preferred skincare product first, then use the massager to help the product penetrate deeper into your skin for enhanced absorption and better results.

settings.label: Subheading

settings.label: Question
settings.default: Who is the device suitable for?

settings.label: Answer
settings.default: The device is designed for all skin types and concerns. It is particularly effective for those seeking to improve skin texture, reduce fine lines, and enhance overall skin clarity. Consult with a dermatologist if you have specific skin conditions.

settings.label: Question
settings.default: How often should I use the device?

settings.label: Answer
settings.default: For optimal results, use the device 3-4 times per week. Begin with 2-3 sessions per week during the first two weeks to allow your skin to adjust. Consistency is key to achieving visible improvements.

settings.label: Question
settings.default: Is it safe for sensitive skin?

settings.label: Answer
settings.default: Yes, the device has been dermatologically tested and is safe for sensitive skin. Start with the lowest intensity setting and gradually increase as your skin builds tolerance. Discontinue use if irritation occurs.

settings.label: Question
settings.default: When can I expect to see results?

settings.label: Answer
settings.default: Most users notice improvements in skin texture and radiance within 2-4 weeks of consistent use. Visible reduction in fine lines and enhanced firmness typically appear after 6-8 weeks. Individual results may vary.

settings.label: Question
settings.default: Can it be used with other skincare products?

settings.label: Answer
settings.default: Yes, the device works effectively with your existing skincare routine. Apply serums or moisturizers after treatment for enhanced absorption. Avoid using with retinol or exfoliating acids immediately before or after treatment.

settings.label: Question
settings.default: How do I clean and store the device?

settings.label: Answer
settings.default: Clean the device head with a soft, damp cloth after each use. Do not submerge in water. Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Ensure the device is completely dry before storing.

settings.default: How does the Facecube Face Massager work?

settings.label: Answer
settings.default: Our Facecube Face Massager uses advanced vibration technology and ergonomic design to provide deep facial massage. The cube-shaped design allows you to target different areas of your face, helping to improve circulation, reduce tension, and promote relaxation.

settings.question: How often should I use the Facecube Face Massager?
settings.answer: For best results, we recommend using the Facecube Face Massager 2-3 times per week, or as needed. Each session should last 5-10 minutes. Consistent use helps maintain skin elasticity and reduces facial tension over time.

settings.question: Is the Facecube Face Massager suitable for sensitive skin?
settings.answer: Yes! The Facecube Face Massager features adjustable intensity levels and is made with hypoallergenic materials. Start with the lowest setting and gradually increase as your skin becomes accustomed. Always use with a clean face and consider applying a light moisturizer or serum before use.

settings.question: Can I use the Facecube Face Massager with skincare products?
settings.answer: Absolutely! The Facecube Face Massager works excellently with serums, moisturizers, and facial oils. Apply your preferred skincare product first, then use the massager to help the product penetrate deeper into your skin for enhanced absorption and better results.

settings.heading: HERITAGE MADE FOR EVERY DAY
settings.subheading: Hand-embroidered pieces designed for the woman who wears her heritage daily. Each Anu saree arrives with a coordinated blouse - no separate sourcing, no guessing.

settings.text: DIRECT ARTISAN PARTNERSHIPS - NO LUXURY MARKUPS - COORDINATED BLOUSE INCLUDED

settings.headline: Traditional Crafts, Contemporary Contexts
settings.story_text: We believe a saree shouldn't require a special occasion to see the light of day. Our collection is an act of reclamation, bridging the gap between ancestral artistry and modern living. Each stitch is a conversation between the artisan and the wearer, resulting in a drape that feels as effortless as a favorite linen shirt. No more ceremonial drawers - just wearable history that speaks fluently in your everyday life.

settings.headline: The Anatomy of the Anu Saree
settings.intro_text: The Anu isn't just a garment; it's a commitment to making ethnic wear an editorial staple in your life, designed for wearability without compromise.
settings.block_1_text: Every pattern is hand-stitched by skilled artisans rather than anonymous factories, ensuring no two pieces are identical and preserving the soul of the craft.
settings.block_2_text: We eliminate the stress of sourcing fabrics. Every saree includes a perfectly matched blouse piece, ensuring proportions and colors are exactly as intended.
settings.block_3_text: Selected for weight and breathability, our fabrics are engineered to stay in place and feel light from morning meetings to late-night dinners.
settings.closing_text: Tradition you can live in, curated for the modern woman who refuses to compartmentalize her culture.

settings.title: Not a Costume
settings.quote: I wore my Anu to a dinner party, not a wedding. It felt like part of my actual wardrobe, not a separate universe. The embroidery is subtle yet stunning.
settings.author: Priya M.

settings.title: Effortless Elegance
settings.quote: The fabric weight is perfect. I didn't feel the need to adjust it once during a 6-hour event. It truly feels like wearable art.
settings.author: Anjali S.

settings.title: Heritage Reclaimed
settings.quote: Finally, a saree that doesn't feel like I'm performing. It honors my roots while fitting my modern lifestyle perfectly.
settings.author: Deepa K.

settings.title: Beautiful Craft
settings.quote: The hand-embroidery is exquisite. You can tell it wasn't made in a factory. It has a soul you can't find elsewhere.
settings.author: Meera R.

settings.title: Perfect Pairing
settings.quote: Having the blouse piece included saved me so much time. The proportions were exactly right and the quality is exceptional.
settings.author: Sanya L.

settings.title: Modern Heirloom
settings.quote: A piece I will keep forever, but also one I will wear tomorrow. That is the magic of Ardraknair's design philosophy.
settings.author: Kavita J.
